plan.title: fix(release-e2e): Windows npm dry-run fails spawnSync pnpm ENOENT (PATHEXT / .cmd)

narratives.Description: release:e2e npm publish dry-run uses spawnSync on a bare pnpm path and ENOENTs on Windows despite pnpm.cmd on PATH. Use the shared win32 PATHEXT-aware spawn helper (same class as #2467) or soft-skip with a clear diagnostic.
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

`task release:e2e` on native Windows completed the GitHub release rehearsal cleanly, then failed the npm publish dry-run leg:

```
[e2e]   rehearsal step: npm publish dry-run... FAIL (pnpm install failed (exit 2): spawnSync C:\Users\msada\AppData\Roaming\npm\pnpm ENOENT)
```

`pnpm` is installed and resolvable from PowerShell (`pnpm.ps1` / `pnpm.cmd` under `%APPDATA%\Roaming\npm`). `where.exe pnpm` finds both the extensionless shim and `pnpm.cmd`. `spawnSync` without `shell: true` does not apply PATHEXT, so the bare `pnpm` path ENOENTs.

## Evidence (v0.77.0 Phase 3)

- clone / set-origin / push-mirror / task release / verify draft / verify tag: **OK**
- npm publish dry-run: **FAIL** (pnpm ENOENT)
- Temp repo destroy: WARN (token lacks `delete_repo`) — leftover `deftai/deftai-release-test-20260714221141-bc7550`

## Expected

- release-e2e npm leg resolves `pnpm` on win32 the same way #2467 / toolchain probes do (prefer `.cmd` / `shell: true` / Corepack)
- Or soft-skip with a clear Windows diagnostic instead of hard-failing a green GitHub rehearsal

## Acceptance

- [ ] `task release:e2e` npm dry-run succeeds on Windows when pnpm.cmd is on PATH
- [ ] Regression test or shared spawn helper covers win32 PATHEXT for pnpm
- [ ] Document `--skip-npm` as GitHub-shape-only escape when npm leg is env-blocked

## Related

- Observed during v0.77.0 Phase 3
- Same class as #2467 (Windows pnpm.cmd / PATHEXT)
- Refs #2547 (Taskfile quoting), #2546 (vitest flake)
narratives.UserStory: As a Windows maintainer, I want release:e2e npm dry-run to find pnpm.cmd, so that Phase 3 does not hard-fail after a green GitHub rehearsal.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Update the release-e2e npm dry-run spawn in packages/core/src/release-e2e/ to resolve pnpm via win32 PATHEXT/.cmd/shell:true using the shared verify-env toolchain helper.
2. Add a vitest unit test that asserts Windows pnpm resolution prefers pnpm.cmd and does not spawn a bare extensionless path that returns ENOENT.
3. Verify with the focused release-e2e test module and a release:e2e --skip-npm smoke when full npm leg remains blocked.
narratives.Acceptance:
1. Windows pnpm spawn succeeds
2. Shared resolution helper used
3. Unit test covers PATHEXT

narrative.Acceptance: Given pnpm.cmd on PATH, when release-e2e runs the npm dry-run install step on win32, then spawn returns without ENOENT and the step proceeds or soft-skips with an explicit diagnostic.
Given the release-e2e npm leg, when it locates pnpm, then it uses the shared win32-aware resolver rather than spawnSync on a bare pnpm path.
Given the new release-e2e unit test, when executed on the win32 branch of the resolver, then it passes for pnpm.cmd resolution and fails if the bare-path ENOENT regresses.
